C3.ai, Inc. is recorded as a public company headquartered in Redwood City, California, trading under the ticker AI. Its profile lists a CIK of 0001577526. The website field associated with the company points to airliquide.com, and the text harvested from that site describes Air Liquide as a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare. That text says Air Liquide serves 4.3 million customers and patients across 59 countries with approximately 65,000 employees, and it announces a research chair in artificial intelligence for chemistry and through chemistry created with the École normale supérieure and its Foundation.

No AI products are tracked for C3.ai, Inc. in the record, and no MCP servers are listed. The record notes no lawsuits involving the company. Its law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.

The material available is thin and largely concerns the site the company is linked to rather than C3.ai itself, so little more can be said from these facts alone.
